query: Which pilot implementation design (randomized pilot, stepped-wedge, cluster RCT) and timeline best demonstrate real-world impact and cost-effectiveness?

response.query: Which pilot implementation design (randomized pilot, stepped-wedge, cluster RCT) and timeline best demonstrate real-world impact and cost-effectiveness?
response.answer: Stepped-wedge cluster RCT design with gradual implementation over time best demonstrates real-world impact and cost-effectiveness. It allows for full evaluation of intervention benefits and minimizes disruption. This design is particularly effective for healthcare settings.
